title: Reading only in the Navy dance band
summary: They discuss how the service bands allowed no faking, though solos were made up and learned numbers could be played without looking.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
